correctness.rationale: The definition and boundary parameters p,q>=1 are explicit. The exact volume partitions coordinates by total range, and for range above one uses extreme points confined to one group; the integration domains, Jacobian and finite expansions are reconstructed in RESULT.md. Strict imbalance follows from an explicitly nonnegative hyperbolic expression; fixed-part asymptotics use a dominated gamma integral. Two independent exact rational integrations agree on 36 cases, and seven independent halfspace convex-hull calculations agree in dimensions 2--5. These finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete two-level poset and rooted complete-tripartite metric are natural objects. The theorem gives a nontrivial exact two-parameter geometric invariant, strict fixed-dimension extremizers, and a sharp asymptotic separating high imbalance from balanced cases. This information is not provided by reflexivity, generic face classification, or standard order-polytope volume. The result is a coherent structural classification, not a single computer-extracted example.
